name: adding-peritoneal-dialysis-program-vignette-hero

name: adding-peritoneal-dialysis-program-01-membrane-mechanism

All typography in IBM Plex Sans, never a serif font. LEFT PANEL, organ-level context: a simplified anterior abdominal cross-section in light gray-blue showing the peritoneal cavity filled with pale teal dialysate, bowel loops suggested simply, and a peritoneal dialysis catheter entering through the abdominal wall and curling into the pelvis; label the panel 'Peritoneal cavity on CAPD' and mark the subcutaneous tunnel and two small Dacron cuffs. Two thin dashed connector boxes lead to two magnified insets at right. UPPER RIGHT INSET with dashed border titled 'Peritoneal membrane, magnified': mesothelial cell layer over interstitium and a capillary in cross-section, small arrows showing solute diffusion across small pores between endothelial cells and free water crossing through aquaporin water channels, with a glucose gradient in the dialysate compartment driving osmotic ultrafiltration; concise callouts only: 'Diffusion down solute gradient', 'Osmotic UF via AQP-1 free-water pathway', 'Membrane is patient-specific and drifts over time'. LOWER RIGHT INSET with dashed border titled 'Exit site and tunnel, magnified': catheter crossing skin and subcutaneous tissue with fibrous tissue ingrowth into the Dacron cuff highlighted pale yellow as anchor and biological barrier; two small red arrows show touch contamination entering at the external connection and travelling down the lumen, and tunnel tracking travelling inward along an immature or infected tract; concise callouts only: 'Cuff ingrowth = anchor + barrier', 'Ingrowth takes time - break-in interval is device- and protocol-specific, use your approved SOP and manufacturer instructions'. BOTTOM SUMMARY FLOW, three boxes left to right joined by thick arrows. Left pale pink box headed 'Injury drivers': touch contamination at the connection; tunnel tracking from exit site; neutrophil influx and fibrin deposition; repeated or refractory episodes; bold final line 'Membrane injury accumulates and is not reversible'. Centre white box with teal border headed 'Programme controls': competency-based training and retraining; scheduled exit-site assessment; 24/7 route to a clinician who can act; validated specimen and culture pathway; lot-traceable on-time supply. Right pale blue box headed 'Expected benefit': preserved membrane function; preserved residual kidney function; sustained technique survival. Add a small italic note beneath reading 'Mechanism figure. Clinical management, antimicrobial selection and dwell prescriptions are governed by approved local SOPs and current ISPD guidance.' Include 'williamriveromd.com' as small semi-transparent navy #0f1e2e text bottom-right at roughly 70% opacity. Avoid photorealism, dark backgrounds, decorative elements, overcrowding, cartoon styling, drop shadows, glossy 3D, tiny unreadable labels, AI gibberish text.
